answer: Because the timing is published against the ripple challenge, the oasis audit can replay the lagoon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 197 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 732 identities would post 522 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
